However, if you’re in an area with lousy internet speeds, adding the VPN layer might ironically slow things down even more, given that your data now has to make a detour through a server somewhere far away. It's like trying to speed up a slow train by attaching a spaceship to it—great in theory, but you might just end up sitting there with a coffee, watching the clock. So, if your connection is solid to begin with, a VPN could indeed help; if not, well, you might need to consider upgrading that internet plan before blaming buffering on your virtual buddy.

This may result in improved streaming quality and reduced buffering.
